intake_variances.statement: Pinned parse/main did not prevalidate finite timeout/available interpreter, and pinned verdict used last Ran plus any OK. Current source checks all summaries and admission; existing three TESTED rows and evidence are preserved exactly. This packet does not requalify tests.

Both pinned and current run_all lack cleanup for already-started owned direct children when a later Popen raises. Frozen spawn-failure cleanup claim overstates baseline but remains an actual accepted cleanup obligation; no N/A or preservation proposed for this edge/aggregate. No fix authored here.

Current shared manifest validation closes optional context shape/value validation before existing host binary checks. Manifest declarations remain distinct from trusted native/installed qualification; DIST-M01 task status and runtime cells unchanged.

Catalog validates initial digest; materialize writes and returns actual snapshot rather than independently proving hostile solver confinement or concurrent source CAS. The frozen guard is interpreted as successful bounded setup/readback; existing three source-preserved rows already state this limit. No claim of an independent expected final-oracle validator.

Dirty/missing/linked/unexpected input rejection applies to declared tracked config/source bytes and merge triples, not globally arbitrary untracked files. Snapshot does not enumerate new untracked TypeScript files or Windows reparse points beyond is_symlink. Preserve actual declared-inventory behavior; no broad clean-tree/hostile-FS guarantee or new membership feature invented.

Recognized double-quoted literal calls and unique source/name sites are scanned; per-file names deduplicate, malformed/unrecognized calls are not parsed as TypeScript errors. Complete source coverage applies to actual supported declarations. Sentinel proves starts, and caller success supplies test-run completion separately. No new TS parser, finishes receipt or container feature invented.
